title: The Great Harvest — Permanent Code Lineage Quarry
objective: Create one permanent Mnemosyne quarry that indexes recoverable OTHRYS/VTC code lineage, including historical Git objects, so future design begins from prior stock instead of rediscovery.
laws: Great Harvest is quarry and evidence navigation, never authority or automatic promotion.
Index metadata and Git retrieval identity; do not duplicate source-code payloads into Mnemosyne.
Collapse equivalent worktrees/repositories by Git lineage before counting stock.
Historical and deleted code remains discoverable but never masquerades as current.
Before redesigning or inventing a capability, consult Great Harvest and record reuse/adapt/reject rationale.
out_of_scope: No automatic code admission or execution
No semantic AI scoring of source code
No rewriting VTC, Hub, Core, or historical repos
